claim_policy: A catalog record is not a pass. Status is assigned per individual case and exact evidence; topical similarity to a Symtropy analytical case is not benchmark equivalence. Verification, numerical verification, and experimental validation are separate claims.

catalogs.catalog_scope: Public catalog lists benchmark summaries and indicates corresponding reference PDFs and input ZIP artifacts; exact artifact contents and redistribution terms must be verified case by case.

catalogs.catalog_version: The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks (P18; original publication 1986)
catalogs.catalog_scope: Independent benchmark family historically intended to challenge finite-element systems beyond vendor-selected demonstration cases; access rights and exact distributable artifacts must be verified per benchmark.
Lists vendor-published verification manuals and included NAFEMS case families; vendor verification is not equivalent to an independent Symtropy reproduction.

benchmarks.title: Joint Deflection of Plane Truss
missing_prerequisites: retrieve and permission-check benchmark PDF/input ZIP
transcribe exact nodes, connectivity, restraints, loads and output target
derive an independent oracle and pin tolerances
benchmarks.notes: Candidate for the first new truss oracle. Not yet reproduced.

benchmarks.title: Beam Stresses and Deflections
missing_prerequisites: match exact section and boundary/load definitions before comparisons
pin source digest and independent reference outputs
benchmarks.notes: Only topic-level overlap with current closed-form functions; must not be called equivalent without input-level reproduction.

benchmarks.title: Buckling of a Bar with Hinged Ends I
missing_prerequisites: benchmark input rights and pinned fixture
benchmarks.notes: Explicit unsupported capability in the current three-case adapter; candidate for a separate model and test tier.

benchmarks.title: Undamped Free Vibration of a Single-Degree-of-Freedom System
missing_prerequisites: closed-form frequency oracle and time-step convergence tests
benchmarks.notes: Candidate expansion after the static truss layer; unsupported by the current adapter.

benchmarks.title: Snap-Through Behaviour of a Truss
missing_prerequisites: nonlinear equilibrium continuation or qualified alternative
benchmarks.notes: Candidate nonlinear benchmark, not a currently supported or safe-for-design capability.

benchmarks.title: Elliptic Membrane
missing_prerequisites: confirm benchmark manual/input access and redistribution rights
reference stress/strain output, locations and tolerances
benchmarks.notes: Candidate for a 2D continuum verification tier after an FE backend exists.

benchmarks.title: Z-Section Cantilever
missing_prerequisites: benchmark geometry and exact load definition
benchmarks.notes: Only shares the word cantilever with a current case; torsion and section coupling are not represented by the current tip-load function.

benchmarks.title: Skew Plate Normal Pressure
benchmarks.notes: Candidate for the continuum/plate capability gap.

benchmarks.title: Solid Cylinder / Taper / Sphere - Temperature
benchmarks.notes: Candidate thermal/structural coupling gap; must remain unsupported until explicitly implemented.
